AI insights

This report is based on Monnit sensor data from 27 July 2026 to 2 August 2026. Temperature peaked at 27.0°C in Ensuite on 30 July at 17:50 and dropped to a low of 19.4°C in Bed 2 on 27 July at 05:50. Humidity peaked at 70.7% in Bed 2 on 28 July at 05:00 and fell to a low of 44.5% in Study on 2 August at 18:50. The tightest condensation margin was 4.6°C in Loft 2, comfortably above the 3°C elevated-risk threshold. Measured against CIBSE Guide A (21°C living areas, 18°C bedrooms, 40-60% RH), the Hall came closest to target at 23.1°C and 58.0% humidity, while Bed 3 sat furthest off at 24.3°C against its 18°C bedroom target. Indoor temperature rose from 21.4°C to a peak of 25.0°C by 30 July before settling to around 24°C for the rest of the week, while humidity fell fairly steadily from 62.4% on 28 July to 50.3% by the week's end. The week's sharpest single swing was in Dining, which climbed 1.3°C between 17:50 and 18:20 on 30 July, consistent with an evening burst of heat such as cooking.
